page.description: Traffic controls for this domain of app {{app}}. Changes apply on the next ingress pass.
page.loadFailed: Could not load this domain's traffic controls.
page.missingApp: Open this page from the Domains list so it knows which app owns the domain.

save.unsaved_one: {{count}} unsaved change, kept as a draft in this browser.
save.unsaved_other: {{count}} unsaved changes, kept as a draft in this browser.

preview.title: Rules preview
preview.help: What happens to a request, in order, with your unsaved draft applied.

overview.tlsReal: Visitors see a publicly trusted certificate, so HSTS can be turned on.
overview.tlsNotReal: No publicly trusted certificate yet (ACME off and no uploaded certificate), so HSTS stays off.
overview.noCert: No certificate has been issued for this domain yet.

redirects.howHelp: Sample requests walked through your current draft, before you save.
redirects.lowercase: Redirect upper case hosts to lower case
redirects.canonicalHelp: Pick one canonical host. The other one redirects to it, keeping the path and query.
redirects.counterpartMissing: {{host}} is not attached to this app yet; applying a redirect preset attaches it.
redirects.counterpartElsewhere: {{host}} belongs to app {{app}}; remove it there first.
redirects.aliasesHelp: Choose one primary domain; every alias redirects to it with the path and query kept.

headers.presetsHelp: One click starting points. Review the fields, then save.
headers.hideServer: Remove Server and X-Powered-By from responses
headers.hstsNeedsTls: HSTS needs a publicly trusted certificate for this domain and stays off until there is one.
headers.corsHelp: Answer cross origin requests at the ingress. Use * only without credentials.
headers.corsHeaders: Allowed request headers (empty echoes what the browser asks for)
headers.rulesHelp: Applied in order. Response rules run after the app answers, so they win over its own headers.
headers.empty: No header rules yet. Add one, or start from a preset.
headers.name: Header

forwarders.title: Path forwarders
forwarders.help: The first matching rule wins. Requests no rule matches go to {{app}}.
forwarders.empty: No forwarders. Every request goes to this domain's app.

geo.title: Geolocation
geo.help: Allow or stop visitors by country. Private and loopback addresses always pass.
geo.sourceHelp: Set APP_GEOIP_DB to a MaxMind or DB-IP country database, or put the instance behind a proxy that sends CF-IPCountry and list it in APP_INGRESS_TRUSTED_PROXIES. Rules are saved but inactive until then.
geo.exempt: Always allowed addresses (one IP or CIDR per line)
geo.privateNote: Requests from private, loopback and link-local addresses are never blocked by country.

access.basicAuthHelp: Ask for a username and password before the app.
access.wafHelp: OWASP rules and per client request limits.

cache.title: Caching
cache.help: Keep responses in the ingress memory. Only GET and HEAD are cached.
cache.safety: Never cached: responses with Set-Cookie, private, no-store or no-cache, and requests with Authorization. Each host has its own entries.
cache.xcacheHelp: Responses on cached paths carry X-Cache: HIT, MISS, STALE or BYPASS.
cache.sparkline: Hits and misses over the last 30 minutes

ports.title: Ports
ports.help: Raw TCP and UDP ports this app exposes. HTTPS for this domain uses port {{port}}.
ports.empty: This app opens no raw ports.
ports.onlyFrom: Open this port only to these IPs
ports.firewallNote: Restrictions are host firewall rules: one allow per address, then a deny for everyone else.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.help: Reset a section to the default behavior. This takes effect on the next ingress pass.
